newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin discusses operation with Germany's Kohl.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin discusses operation with Germany's Kohl.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin discussed his forthcoming heart surgery with German Chancellor Helmut Kohl in a short telephone conversation on Friday, the presidential press service said.
The two leaders focused on preparations for Yeltsin's bypass operation, which is expected to take place in late November, it said.
The conversation was conducted "in the spirit of traditional friendship that characterises relations between the two statesmen", it added.
Kohl, a personal friend of the Russian leader and one of his key Western backers, wished Yeltsin a speedy recovery from the operation, which will improve bloody supply to his heart.
In a radio address on Friday, Yeltsin sounded clear and confident as he rapped officials jostling for power during his absence from the political centre-stage.

His wife Naina told Russian television on Thursday night that Yeltsin, who is staying at the Barvikha sanitorium near Moscow, was keen to have his operation and get back to work in the Kremlin as soon as possible.
